android.desc:
Workout Trainer is your all-in-one fitness coach, powered by AI and guided by top experts, to help you reach your goals wherever you train. Follow your personalized weekly plan with high-quality multimedia workouts for every fitness level.

Choose from thousands of bodyweight, strength, and rep-based workouts plus 70+ sports and activities. Track everything from GPS distance to weights, reps, and sets, making Workout Trainer your complete fitness companion. With thousands of curated workouts, including routines led by your favorite YouTube fitness celebrities, it’s like having a personal trainer in your pocket. 💪 Join our global community of fitness fanatics, climb the leaderboard, and stay motivated as you crush your goals together.

🔥 New: Video-based Form Feedback! Snap a short exercise video of yourself and get an instant report with your Form Score and Technique Tips so you can move better, train safer, and see results faster.

📊 Advanced Heart Rate and Performance Tracking
Connect your Wear OS smartwatch or Bluetooth LE heart-rate monitor to unlock powerful insights:
• Real-time heart-rate feedback during workouts
• Zone tracking to optimize fat burn, endurance, and strength
• Detailed heart-rate graphs for every exercise
• Performance comparisons to help you improve week after week
Workout Trainer turns your data into a smarter training plan so every workout counts.

Optionally get access to your 1:1 AI trainer, 100+ multi-week training programs, advanced heart rate performance analysis and more with a PRO+ membership experience. Simply subscribe in-app for $9.99/month or $89.99/year.

/// ONLINE TRAINING ///
Need that extra push? Hire one of our dedicated coaches for 1:1 Online Personal Training. Get custom training programs tailored to your needs, stay accountable, and reach your goals faster with the help of a real online trainer.
/// CERTIFIED PERSONAL TRAINERS ///
Are you a fitness professional? Sign up today to get free access to our innovative trainer tools and coaching solutions. Grow your brand and online training business and reach millions of people who want to live fit.
/// STAY CONNECTED ///
Stay motivated for free with our community. All your training and social activity is synchronized with our www.skimble.com website.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Don’t let excuses hold you back. Your fitness journey starts here. Downl
